summary: Comprehensive testing of Enhanced Penalty & Compliance System with 5 tabs. Fixed critical backend route ordering issue where PUT /api/penalties/rule-config was being matched by /{penalty_id} route. All 22 backend tests pass, all UI elements verified.

fixed.issue: Route was being matched by /{penalty_id} due to FastAPI route ordering - rule-config was defined after parameterized routes
fixed.fix: Moved /rule-config routes before /{penalty_id} routes in penalties.py

critical_code_review_comments: Route ordering in FastAPI is critical - specific routes like /rule-config must be defined BEFORE parameterized routes like /{penalty_id}
seed_data_creation: Test penalties created during backend tests with TEST_ prefix
